fields.statement: Change set 'Text references' (01M6HNN) serves no intent yet. Its leaf comes from the accepted Area model umbrella (01M5SWSWDVB237). That umbrella serves the roots anyone-builds and model-tells-truth, and its capability text-references is decided-by references-by-id. Which intent should it serve, and how does the leaf come over? / Text references: what form is stored, and which text fields are scanned? Today the log holds '@' only inside emails, 'checkout@v7' and one quoted '@key'. / Text references: what does a write do when @handle names no node it may refer to? The write rules say a write may refer only to landed nodes and nodes of its own change set. / Text references: how are stored references shown, and what does rhiza check flag?
